description: This file defines the SearchForm class used in SuiteCRM to generate and handle search forms, including basic and advanced search capabilities, tab management, populating search fields, and rendering search UI elements.

classes.name: SearchForm
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering and processing search forms in SuiteCRM, including handling of search fields, tabs, display logic, and generation of SQL WHERE clauses based on user input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the search form, loads metadata, and sets up tabs based on available views.

methods.name: populateFromArray
methods.description: Populates search fields from a provided array, typically from user input or request parameters.

methods.name: populateFromRequest
methods.description: Populates search fields directly from the $_REQUEST superglobal.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Builds an array of SQL WHERE clauses based on current search field values.

methods.name: displayTabs
methods.description: Renders the HTML for the top tabs of the search form.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the search form by assigning variables to the template engine, including populating options and default values.

methods.name: displayHeader
methods.description: Displays the header of the search form, including tabs and layout links.

methods.name: displayWithHeaders
methods.description: Displays the entire search form with headers, including tabs and form sections.

methods.name: displayBasic
methods.description: Renders the basic search form view.

methods.name: displayAdvanced
methods.description: Renders the advanced search form view.

methods.name: displaySavedViews
methods.description: Displays saved search views and their form.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML for the search action buttons, including search, clear, and saved filter options.
